change: First S: the first S on a foe pays its gold once more

mutations.name: every S pays
mutations.find: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return l==='S' && this.best(had)!=='S' ? foe.gold : 0; },
mutations.replace: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return l==='S' ? foe.gold : 0; },

mutations.name: an A pays too
mutations.find: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return l==='S' && this.best(had)!=='S' ? foe.gold : 0; },
mutations.replace: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return (l==='S'||l==='A') && this.best(had)!=='S' ? foe.gold : 0; },

mutations.name: half the gold
mutations.find: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return l==='S' && this.best(had)!=='S' ? foe.gold : 0; },
mutations.replace: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return l==='S' && this.best(had)!=='S' ? Math.round(foe.gold/2) : 0; },

mutations.name: an old clear never pays
mutations.find: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return l==='S' && this.best(had)!=='S' ? foe.gold : 0; },
mutations.replace: sBonus(had, l, foe){ return l==='S' && had!==true && this.best(had)!=='S' ? foe.gold : 0; },

mutations.name: the bonus is not counted up
the bonus reads the new clear
the bonus is said but never paid
